newsitem.title: USA: Stone & Webster sees 15 pct earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Stone & Webster sees 15 pct earnings growth.

text.p: Stone & Webster Inc said Monday it "continues to track well" against it goal of 15 percent annual earnings growth.
The company reported first quarter operating earnings per share of $0.43 compared to $0.59 in the same quarter last year.
The company said it expects margins will strengthen in the next few quarters from the higher margin business mix in backlog.

"We continue to obtain new orders with margins that are higher than historic levels, and our success at winning new awards during the quarter continues to increase our backlog," said a statement issued by the company.
Profitability from ongoing operations, while below last year's very strong first quarter, was in line with forecasts, the company said.

The quarter's operating results do not, as yet, reflect the completion of the company's headquarters' consolidation and further management actions the company has taken to move towards its goal of 15 percent return on shareholders' equity, Stone & Webster said.
